implementation.factories: Probe copy admission under MEMORY_OBJECTS, then fallibly prepare vector capacity outside it with no copied frame identity, Rust borrow or source pin. Existing containing IPC/fixture contexts remain.
implementation.publication: Recheck captured full namespace handle, object ID, size, capability/read rights/source ownership, loan/retirement/DMA fences, writable mappings and pin overflow under one registry hold. Fill prepared snapshot and increment original pin without allocation.
implementation.ordinary_disposal: Unused/rejected snapshot preparation explicitly disposes after registry unlock. Explicit unpin frees snapshot before original pin decrement; existing deferred backing release remains after memory unlock.
implementation.fallback: Preparing and bare CopyPin use inert fields. Guarded abandonment retains snapshot metadata and original backing fence without allocator/registry entry. Empty source-escrow pins use the same owner with no snapshot.
remaining: concurrent snapshot candidates and retained vectors lack independent byte/count or aggregate signed-principal admission
ScopedCopyPin automatic unpin and source-transfer/ordinary backing rollback destructors
DMA snapshot factories and broader enclosing IPC/lifecycle/IRQ/guard contexts
sustained concurrent pressure, essential-service progress and historical failure attribution
